label: baseline-ledger_d
bash_commands: python3 ops.py reconcile --account production --month 2026-08 --contract billing_service --json-out report.json
python3 ops.py revenue-contract > contract.json && cat contract.json

python3 -c "import json; from datetime import datetime, timezone; from dateutil import parser; data = json.load(open('ledger.json')); result = {}; seen = {}; def in_august_2026(dt): d = parser.isoparse(dt).astimezone(timezone.utc); return datetime(2026,8,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc) <= d < datetime(2026,9,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc); for row in data: eid = row['event_id']; rev = row['revision']; if (eid not in seen) or (rev > seen[eid]['revision']): seen[eid] = row; included = {'status': 'settled', 'customer_id': 'account-205'}; filtered = [r for r in seen.values() if all(r[k]==v for k,v in included.items()) and in_august_2026(r['occurred_at'])]; totals_minor = {}; included_event_ids = []; for r in filtered: c = r['currency']; amt = r['amount_minor'] if r['kind']=='capture' else -r['amount_minor']; totals_minor[c] = totals_minor.get(c,0)+amt; included_event_ids.append(r['event_id']); out = {'totals_minor':totals_minor, 'included_event_ids':sorted(set(included_event_ids))}; json.dump(out, open('report.json','w')); print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))"
